summary: Repaired the triangular batch matmul mismatch class (12 MISMATCH cases: tril_matmul_kernel_6d320d58 at [127]/[128] x fp32/fp16/bf16, triu_batch_kernel at [17]/[120] x fp32/fp16/bf16; recorded MISMATCH in full-scan run 7f702b5c). Attempt-1's worker died inactively with its work unreported on the tree; this attempt judged that on-tree work (all four fixes verified present, reviewed and re-executed) and completed the verification. Two shared-path defects behind one symptom class, each localized by stage bisection to the FIRST incorrect stage. (1) tril class, first incorrect stage = FRONTEND constexpr evaluation (a100c/frontend/specialize.py): `not <RuntimeValue>` silently folded to constant False -- RuntimeValue defines no __bool__, so the object's truthiness (True) leaked through `not` and `if not is_above:` baked the all-zeros else arm at compile time; the dot, the k-loop and the triangular tl.where never lowered. Witness: the pre-fix cached artifact a100c/cache/41d53648.../stage.tir.txt (old compiler provenance a100c/80d3ce0a2de50a70) has 29 tir_ops, NO linalg.dot, NO logical.not and C_ptr-only address trees (the loads were DCE'd away); the recorded mismatch showed C zero at kept (i>=j) positions. Fix: the UnaryOp arm of the constexpr evaluator declines a RuntimeValue operand exactly like the T016 BoolOp guard, so the condition routes to the runtime-if path and lowers logical.not. (2) triu class, first incorrect stage = MIR LOWERING arange materialization (a100c/lower/vectorize.py): tl.arange always materialized as the pass's raw chunk positions (vid+elem) regardless of the arange's own start/extent; an extent-1 arange (BATCH_BLOCK_SIZE=1) is a splat source that joins any open pass and the T039 extent-1 staging store writes element 0 from EVERY lane, so the staged slot held the last lane's raw position -- triu's row mask compared pid+(elem+vl-1) < batch, false for every chunk, the store was fully masked off and Y kept its -7 fill. Witness: pre-fix cached artifacts (e.g. a100c/cache/5dd63035.../stage.mir.lowered.txt) carry TWO vid ops; the current artifact carries exactly one (the block arange) with the extent-1 site as s2v splats of const 0. Fix: the arange materialization emits the arange's OWN values -- a splat of start when extent==1, start+(vid+elem) when start!=0 (the start==0 corpus majority keeps byte-identical codegen; the corpus has no nonzero-start arange, verified by survey). Two enabling repairs the corrected tril form then needed, same stage-bisect walk: (3) TIR verifier join scope tracking (a100c/ir/tir.py): joins define the join value's scope names (aliases included) exactly like op results, so an arm binding a join name to a loop-join value by alias (`c_tile = acc`) resolves for the both-arms rule; the malformed ghost-name control is still rejected (CARRIED_WITHOUT_JOIN). (4) scalar re-materialization rung (a100c/lower/vectorize.py): a mid-pass scalar unary (the logical.not of the runtime if's condition) re-materializes at its post-close use via the scalar core (not/neg/fneg); unhandled scalar unaries refuse with a located diagnostic. All fixes are in shared paths with no per-operator branch (tools/check_no_name_dispatch.py PASS over 35 pipeline files, behavioral name-generality identical). Verification executed at the current tree: all 12 cases execute and compare PASS under their declared policies at 1 and 4 workers (triu outputs bit-exact max_abs_err=0.0; tril fp32 ~5.7e-6, fp16/bf16 at input-precision level); regression test a100c/tests/test_t043_repairs.py (5 checks with differential controls that reproduce each pre-fix behavior) exits 0; neighbors matmul_kernel_10d5c480 (control.where+linalg.dot+masked loads, the tril tag set) 6/6 and gemm_rowstats_group_tc_kernel 2/2 PASS at 1 and 4 threads, plus an arange blast over the 12-arange kernels fused_recurrent_fwd_kernel and parallel_attn_fwd_kernel and norm__l2_norm_kernel_2 (18/18 PASS); the full a100c test suite green (49/49 test files rc=0 -- test_t039_repairs needed a 2400s re-run after the loop's own 1200s bound cut it, rc=0 in 1375s, both records kept -- and the cold compile sweep: 2116 artifacts + 0 refusals = 2116 identities, 0 over-budget, 0 crashes, 618/618 repeat cases reused one artifact, 5431s).
